subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which linked generator PR should be refreshed or superseded as the canonical fix for this issue?
rationale: Main and the latest release still lack Markdown generation/check wiring, while two open PRs target the issue and both currently conflict with main; choosing the branch or replacement path is maintainer coordination, not a new issue repair.

options.title: Refresh PR 89142
options.body: Use the broader candidate with formatter tests and supplied proof as the canonical path, then resolve conflicts before normal review.

options.title: Ask PR 91612 to refresh
options.body: Keep the direct closing PR as the path only if its author refreshes the branch and supplies acceptable real behavior proof.

options.title: Open a maintainer replacement
options.body: Use a new narrow replacement only if neither contributor branch can be practically rebased or adopted.

recommendation.title: Refresh PR 89142
recommendation.body: Use the broader candidate with formatter tests and supplied proof as the canonical path, then resolve conflicts before normal review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the most direct maintenance of SecretRef docs and generated-doc tooling around this surface.
